segments.text: Companies already have the data to match people with projects. They just can't see it.
Meet [PRODUCT]. An HR manager opens a new project and asks: who should staff this?
In seconds, [PRODUCT] ranks internal candidates by skills, availability and growth potential, and explains why.
It also flags the skill gaps the organization will face next quarter, before they become hiring costs.
[KEY METRIC]: from weeks of manual search to minutes. Built on NTT DATA's own data. Ready to scale.
